visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up stationary shot of multiple packages of Taiwanese mullet roe snacks spread out on a table. In the background, a shelf is densely packed with various colorful action figures and robot models under bright studio lights. (2) A man wearing a black cap, rectangular glasses, and a dark navy sweatshirt with white Korean characters "천재" appears in a medium shot. He gestures emphatically with his hands while looking directly at the lens. Behind him, the studio walls are white with some decorative panels. (3) The frame transitions into a split-screen layout. The top half shows two men on a grey couch, one in a white hoodie and the other in a black hoodie. The bottom half shows the man from the previous phase sitting with a companion in a striped blue and yellow shirt. They all hold product samples. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a small, individual vacuum-sealed piece of sliced mullet roe being held between a man's fingers. Yellow variety-show style text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen. The man's facial expressions are exaggerated and joyful. (5) The scene cuts back to the group of men in a wider shot. The man in the white hoodie holds a white sheet of paper and appears to be reading specifications or promotional details while the others react with laughter and pointing gestures. The camera pans slightly across the various bags of food items, showing the brand logo "@就是愛海鮮" clearly. (7) The final sequence is a montage of rapid cuts showing different members of the group tasting the mullet roe, nodding in approval, and pointing toward the camera with enthusiastic expressions. Text overlays like "Really convenient" appear in bright colors.
